extracted.name: Blueberry smoothie recipe
extracted.description: Make a quick and simple blueberry smoothie with yogurt, banana and apple juice for busy mornings. You can easily make it vegan by using coconut yogurt
ingredient_lines: 3-4 mint leaves (optional), plus extra to garnish
instruction_lines: Put the blueberries, banana, yogurt, apple juice and mint, if using, in a blender and blitz until smooth. Add a splash of water if it seems too thick.
Pour the smoothie into a tall glass with a glass straw to serve. Garnish with a sprig of mint, if you like.
